summary: Destroys the hidden async-socket message window: if global handle dword_8D3E28 is non-zero it calls DestroyWindow on it, unregisters the window class via UnregisterClassA using lpClassName and the HINSTANCE at this[477], clears the global handle to 0, and returns 1; otherwise returns 0 immediately.

operations.description: If dword_8D3E28 (async-socket window handle) is non-zero, perform cleanup; otherwise return 0 with no work.
UnregisterClassA(lpClassName, this[477]) removes the registered window class using the HINSTANCE stored at this+0x774.
Clear the global window handle dword_8D3E28 to 0.
Return 1 when the window existed and was destroyed; return 0 when dword_8D3E28 was already zero. Invoked by caller sub_57BCE0.
